title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: X is a (tame, e.g. Whitney/Thom–Mather) stratified space with closed strata X_i indexed by a poset I, where k<i means X_k ⊂ X_i. The boundary of X_i is written Ẋ_i = ∪_{k<i} X_k, and X_i^* = X_i \ Ẋ_i is the open stratum. The page is §19, a heuristic description of the pieces of the 'déploiement' (unfolding) of X. The unfolding is the ordered space Σ of the previous page, with Σ(0) = ∐ Σ_i and Σ(1) = ∐_{i<j} Σ_ij. It carries two maps: s: Σ_ij → Σ_i, meant to be a proper fibration, and b: Σ_ij → Σ_j, meant to be a proper immersion onto a boundary face.

(1) Construction of Σ_i. Choose a 'standard' tubular neighbourhood T_{<i} of Ẋ_i. A marginal NB says to take T_{<i} = ∪_{k<i} T_k, a union of standard tubes of the lower strata, chosen in a larger ambient space X^+. Write T°_{<i} = T_{<i} \ Ṫ_{<i} for the open tube. Then (92) sets Σ_i = X_i \ (X_i ∩ T°_{<i}). This is X_i with an open regular neighbourhood of its singular locus removed: a compact manifold with corners whose interior is homeomorphic to the open stratum X_i^*. A second NB notes that for Σ_i alone it would suffice to use a tube inside X_i itself.

(2) Construction of Σ_ij for i<j. Put X'_j = X_j \ (X_j ∩ T°_{<i}). Take a tubular neighbourhood T'_ij of Σ_i in X'_j, small relative to the choice of T_{<i}. This time T_{<i} must be standard in X (or at least in X_j), so that the traces on the different strata are coherent. Its boundary Ṫ'_ij is a bundle over Σ_i whose fibre is the link of X_i in X_j. That fibre is still stratified by the intermediate strata X_k with i<k<j. Their trace on Ṫ'_ij is the 'singular part' SṪ'_ij, which is empty if j covers i. Remove an open standard tube T°(SṪ'_ij) of this singular part. This tube is taken to be induced by the union of standard tubes of the X_k (i<k<j), chosen small relative to the earlier choices. This gives (93): Σ_ij = Ṫ'_ij \ T°(SṪ'_ij).

Result and purpose. Σ_ij fibres over Σ_i with fibre the truncated link, a manifold with boundary; this is the s-map. The next page states that Σ_ij ⊂ Σ_j as a boundary face, provided the choices are made coherently; this is the b-map. The sketch figure shows a point stratum with its tube and higher-stratum branches emanating from it. The page then leads into the inductive construction (next page) by a strictly increasing dimension function δ: I → N, the filtration X_(d), and successive tubes T_0, T_1, … chosen in the complements of the previous open tubes.

The overall aim is to replace a stratified space by a diagram of manifolds with corners, the strata 'unfolded', linked by fibrations and boundary inclusions. This is the 'théorème de déploiement' programme of tame topology announced in Esquisse d'un programme.
errors: No real error, but a gap: the union T_{<i} = ∪T_k of individual tubes only behaves as a 'standard' tube if the tubes are mutually compatible (Mather-type control conditions: commuting retractions and radial functions). The page passes over this, relying only on 'assez petits' choices. The coherence needed for Σ_ij ⊂ Σ_j and for the triple intersections Σ_ih ∩ Σ_jh = Σ_ijh is deferred to the next page.
The claim that s: Σ_ij → Σ_i is a fibration requires local triviality of the tube along Σ_i (Thom's isotopy lemma / tame topology); here it is heuristic, as the title acknowledges.
Notational overload: the dot denotes both the boundary Ẋ_i of a closed stratum (= union of lower strata) and the boundary Ṫ of a tube, while T° denotes the open tube.

ideas.what: Unfolding (déploiement) of a stratified space into manifolds with corners Σ_i obtained by deleting open tubular neighbourhoods of lower strata
ideas.modern_name: Resolution / unzipping of Thom–Mather stratified spaces into manifolds with corners with iterated fibration structure
ideas.usually_credited_to: Verona (1984, resolution of stratified spaces); Albin–Leichtnam–Mazzeo–Piazza (2012); Ayala–Francis–Tanaka (2017, 'unzipping'); ideas going back to Thom and Mather
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (§5–6, tame topology and the 'théorème de déploiement' of stratified spaces), announced only in outline

ideas.what: Boundary pieces Σ_ij = link bundle over Σ_i minus a tube of its intermediate-strata singular part, fibring over Σ_i and embedded as a face of ∂Σ_j
ideas.modern_name: Boundary fibration structure / iterated fibration structure (boundary hypersurfaces fibring over lower resolved strata)

ideas.what: Inductive construction of tubes via a strictly increasing dimension function and nested choices 'small relative to previous choices'
ideas.modern_name: Control data / systems of tubular neighbourhoods (Mather)

missed.claim: An explicit construction of the unfolding pieces Σ_i, Σ_ij, intended to produce Grothendieck's axiomatic 'ordered space' Σ (proper fibration s, proper bounding immersion b) from the previous page. It predates by decades the essentially identical 'unzipping' (Ayala–Francis–Tanaka) and the ALMP resolution. It is not a new result today, since Verona and others did it in the 1980s, but the details of Grothendieck's own version of the déploiement announced in the Esquisse are not in the record.
missed.quote: Σ_ij = Ṫ'_ij \ T°(ST'_ij) ... de sorte qu'on ait Σ_ij ⊂ Σ_j
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical credit: it documents that Grothendieck had worked out the resolution-to-corners picture underlying modern stratified homotopy theory and exit-path categories, and not merely announced it.

deep.surprise_reason: The construction is a careful but standard tube-removal resolution, already known (Mather, Verona) or later rediscovered (ALMP, AFT); the déploiement idea itself is announced in the Esquisse. Mild interest as documentation of Grothendieck's version.
transcription_corrections: Marginal NB may read 'On pourrait prendre T_{<i} = ∪_{k<i} T_k, où les T_k sont des vois. tub. standard dans X^+' (reading 'pourrait' vs 'prend' uncertain).
'(pris "assez petits" ...)' appears as '(puis "assez petits" p.r. aux choix déjà faits des T_{<i} et des T'_ij)'.
In (93) the removed set is the open tube T°(SṪ'_ij); the handwriting shows Ṫ'_ij \ T°(SṪ'_ij), consistent with the transcription.
'On aura donc' replaces struck 'On prend' before (93), as transcribed; the inserted word above may be 'aura'.
